999008199.text: お客人、歓迎の宴の準備が整っているぞ

localizations.en: Our guests, the welcome feast is ready for you!

999008199.text: えっ、アタシたちのためにわざわざ！？

localizations.en: Oh! You went to all this trouble just for us!?

999008199.text:
錬金術の品を見せてもらうのに、
タダというわけにはいかない

localizations.en: I can't simply ask to see your alchemical goods for free.

999008199.text:
こちらも誠意を見せなくてはと思ってな。
さあ、こっちだ

localizations.en: I thought I should show my sincerity as well. Come, this way.

999008199.text: わぁ……！
綺麗……！

神聖国では桜も珍しいのではないか？
ここケイウンには四季と呼ばれるものがあってな

localizations.en: Cherry blossoms must be rare in the sacred lands, aren't they? Here in Keiun, we have something called the four seasons.

999008199.text:
時期によって気候が変化し、
草花たちも異なる姿を見せるのだ

localizations.en: The climate changes with the times, and the plants and flowers show different faces.

999008199.text: へえー！　なんか面白そう！
今はちょうど桜の見頃なのだ。いい頃合いに来たな

localizations.en: Right now is the perfect time to view the cherry blossoms. You came at just the right moment.

999008199.text: 素敵な景色が見られて、運がよかったわね

localizations.en: How lucky that we get to see such a lovely view.

999008199.text:
さあ皆の者。お客人がたがお見えになったぞ。
宴の始まりだ！

localizations.en: Come, everyone! Our honored guests have arrived. Let the feast begin!

999008199.text:
呼び出されるどころか、迎えに来てもらっちゃったね。
話が早くて助かるけど……

localizations.en: Not only weren't we summoned, but she came to meet us personally. It helps that things are moving quickly, but...

999008199.text:
相手に主導権を握られてるってことだし
用心はしていかないとね

localizations.en: It also means she's got the upper hand. We should stay on our guard.

999008199.text:
見て、あのお魚、脂乗ってるよ！
絶対美味しいやつ！

localizations.en: Look at that fish—it's so fresh! This is definitely the good stuff!

999008199.text:
あれ、生魚ですよね！？
お腹壊しちゃったりしない？

localizations.en: Wait, raw fish!? Won't you get sick?

999008199.text:
たまに壊すけど、新鮮で美味しいから挑戦するんだよ。
大丈夫、そうそう中らないから

localizations.en: Sometimes I do, but it's fresh and delicious, so I always give it a try. Don't worry, I hardly ever get food poisoning.

999008199.text:
私の故郷でもよく食べてた。
生が一番美味しいのよ、姉様

localizations.en: We ate a lot of it back home too. Raw is the best way to have it.

999008199.text: そ、そうなのかあ～……なら挑戦してみよっかな

localizations.en: I-I see... Maybe I should give it a try then.

999008199.text:
待たせたな。早速、宴……と行きたいが
これもしきたり、祝詞を受けてもらう

localizations.en: Sorry to keep you waiting. I'd like to start the feast right away, but custom demands that you first receive a blessing.

999008199.text: のりと……ですか？

新しきを好む余ではあるが、これは好きだ。
千歳の見せ場だからな

localizations.en: Though I favor new things, I'm fond of this tradition. It's Chitose's moment to shine, after all.

999008199.text:
ともかく、皆は黙ってここに立っているだけでいい。
あとは千歳がすべて取り計らってくれる……千歳！

localizations.en: Anyway, all you need to do is stand here quietly. Chitose will take care of everything... Chitose!

999008199.text:
は、はじめまして……堂免家付きの巫女……
波照間千歳と、申します

localizations.en: N-nice to meet you... I'm the shrine maiden serving the Domen family... Chitose Hateruma.

999008199.text:
祝詞を奏上させて、いただきます。
よろしく、お願い、します……

localizations.en: I will recite a blessing for you. Please... bear with me...

999008199.text:
ああ。千歳の修練、余はしっかり見てきたぞ。
異国の客人相手でも儀礼は変わらん、平常心で行こう

localizations.en: I've watched Chitose's training for a long time now. Even foreign guests get the authentic experience.

999008199.text: なんというか……神々しい方ですね

localizations.en: She has such... a divine presence.

999008199.text:
初め、千歳は堂免家ではなく神社に住み込みで
役割をこなしていたのだが

localizations.en: At first, Chitose lived at the shrine and performed her duties there.

999008199.text:
余は、この無垢で清廉なたたずまいを初めて見たとき
雷が落ちたような衝撃を受けた。一目惚れ、だな

localizations.en: But when I first saw her pure and noble bearing, I was struck like lightning. Love at first sight, you could say.

999008199.text:
それから神社に通いつめ、雨の日も雪の日も
千歳を堂免家に迎えたいと熱弁し、口説き落としたのだ

localizations.en: After that, I visited the shrine constantly, through rain and snow, passionately arguing why I wanted to bring Chitose into the Domen family, until I won her over.

999008199.text: 鏑矢様……もう……恥ずかしい、です

localizations.en: Lady Kaburaya... please... you're embarrassing me.

999008199.text:
それだけお前が欲しかったんだ。
たった一度の人生、わがままなくらいがちょうどいい

localizations.en: That's just how much I wanted you. In this one life we have, being a little selfish is just right.

999008199.text: では千歳、頼むぞ

localizations.en: Now then, Chitose, if you would.

999008199.text:
天地初めて発りし時
黄金星に成る神の名は――

localizations.en: When heaven and earth first came to be, the name of the god who became the golden star was—

999008199.text:
（千歳さんの歌のような言葉の意味は、
　あまりよく分からなかったけど……）

localizations.en: (I didn't really understand the meaning of Chitose's song-like words...)

999008199.text: （その音はとても綺麗で、美しくて……）

localizations.en: (But the sound was so beautiful and lovely...)

999008199.text:
（鏑矢さんが自分のものにしたいと思った気持ちも
　少し分かる気がした）

localizations.en: (I think I understand a little why Kaburaya wanted to make her her own.)

999008199.text:
堂免家付きの巫女。
物静かで儚い印象だが、内には１本の芯がある

localizations.en: A shrine maiden serving the Domen family. Though she appears quiet and fragile, she possesses an inner strength.
